other.name: Molech
other.description: The idol to whom the law forbids giving seed through the fire (Leviticus 18:21, 20:2-5)

other.name: Chemosh
other.description: "O people of Chemosh" (Numbers 21:29); the god of Moab

other.name: Baal
other.description: A god Israel served when they forsook the Lord (Judges 2:13); "the high places of Baal" (Numbers 22:41)

other.name: Baal-peor
other.description: The god of Peor, to whom Israel joined himself in Shittim (Numbers 25:1-5)

other.name: Baalim
other.description: The Baals: "the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and served Baalim" (Judges 2:11, 3:7, 8:33, 10:6, 10:10)

other.name: Ashtaroth
other.description: Strange gods Israel served and put away (Judges 2:13, 1 Samuel 7:3-4, 12:10); in their house the Philistines put Saul's armour (1 Samuel 31:10)

other.name: Baal-berith
other.description: Whom Israel made their god after Gideon died (Judges 8:33, 9:4)

other.name: Berith
other.description: Baal-berith: "the house of the god Berith" at Shechem (Judges 9:46)

other.name: Dagon
other.description: The god of the Philistines (Judges 16:23)

other.name: Ashtoreth
other.description: The goddess of the Zidonians, after whom Solomon went (1 Kings 11:5, 11:33)

other.name: Milcom
other.description: "the abomination of the Ammonites", after whom Solomon went (1 Kings 11:5, 11:33)

other.name: Baal-zebub
other.description: The god of Ekron, whom Ahaziah sent to enquire of (2 Kings 1:2-16)

other.name: Rimmon
other.description: The god of Syria, in whose house Naaman's master worshipped (2 Kings 5:18)

other.name: Ashima
other.description: A god the men of Hamath made in the cities of Samaria (2 Kings 17:30)

other.name: Nergal
other.description: A god the men of Cuth made in the cities of Samaria (2 Kings 17:30)

other.name: Succoth-benoth
other.description: A god the men of Babylon made in the cities of Samaria (2 Kings 17:30)

other.name: Adrammelech
other.description: A god of Sepharvaim, to whom the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire (2 Kings 17:31)

other.name: Anammelech
other.description: A god of Sepharvaim, to whom the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire (2 Kings 17:31)

other.name: Nibhaz
other.description: A god the Avites made in the cities of Samaria (2 Kings 17:31)

other.name: Tartak
other.description: A god the Avites made in the cities of Samaria (2 Kings 17:31)

other.name: Nehushtan
other.description: The brasen serpent that Moses had made, to which Israel burned incense; Hezekiah brake it in pieces and called it Nehushtan (2 Kings 18:4)

other.name: Nisroch
other.description: The god of Sennacherib, in whose house he was slain (2 Kings 19:37)

other.name: Tirshatha
other.description: The governor's title: "the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things" (Ezra 2:63); Nehemiah 8:9 names "Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha"
